changes: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/aiAgents/{agentUuid}/threads/{threadUuid}/messages/{messageUuid}/queries — api path removed without deprecation
GET /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/aiAgents/{agentUuid}/threads/{threadUuid}/messages/{messageUuid}/queries/{queryUuid}/query-results — api path removed without deprecation
GET /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/aiAgents/{agentUuid}/threads/{threadUuid}/messages/{messageUuid}/queries/{queryUuid}/viz-query — api path removed without deprecation

declaredAdvisories.reason: The AI agent message query pipeline REST routes under /messages/{messageUuid}/queries are removed in favour of node-addressed routes. Anything calling them now gets 404. No shipped UI opens these routes: the footer that used them was removed earlier, so an old browser tab or UI pod never requests them during a rolling update, and only the removed routes are affected.

impact.firstPartyOnly: The web app's AI agent message footer was the only client of these operations and was removed before this change; nothing in the web app, SDK or CLI calls them today, so during a rolling update an old tab behaves exactly as before and never hits the removed routes.
